subject.title: fix(hooks): report agent startup admission failures

question: Should agent hooks cancel a run that has not reached runner entry within 15 seconds, including time spent waiting for session admission?
rationale: The current hook contract accepts work immediately, while this PR introduces an externally visible SLA and cancellation policy whose duration and ownership are not established by existing code or docs.

options.title: Define owner-level deadline
options.body: Add a typed isolated-run admission deadline and tests for queued, admitted, and timed-out work before changing the hook HTTP contract.

options.title: Accept the hook-local SLA
options.body: Keep the 15-second hook-owned cancellation policy and document that callers must retry 503 responses with idempotency handling.

options.title: Wait without cancellation
options.body: Return a timeout response without aborting the queued run, accepting that retries need a separate durable status or dedupe design.

recommendation.title: Define owner-level deadline
recommendation.body: Add a typed isolated-run admission deadline and tests for queued, admitted, and timed-out work before changing the hook HTTP contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced both the shared runner-entry callback and the detached hook continuation whose product contract is being changed.
